milestones.title: Prove that delayed key grants cannot allow writes under a key known to a revoked device and that unaffected cells still accept writes.

remediation: Commit the current key recipients or pending rotations to authenticated history so a replica can verify whether the current key is safe for new work during partial synchronization. Keep affected writes paused until that proof or a verified rotation arrives.
title: A computer can lack proof that a revoked device held the current cell key
